deals.postCaption: Can’t miss events in Vienna this August 2026 🥳 🏮 Alte Donau Lichterlfest 1 August | 1220 Vienna For one night the Alter Donau is covered in lights! 🎥 Film Festival an Rathausplatz @filmfestivalrathausplatz Until 6 September | 1010 Vienna Free nightly film + music performances in from of the Rathaus, with a wide range of delicious food and drinks! 🎬 Kino am Dach Until 12 September | 1070 Vienna Open-air movie screenings on the rooftop of the main library - the perfect Vienna summer evening! 🎶 Isle of Summer Featival @isleofsummer_vienna 1 August | 1220 Vienna A brand-new open air electronic music featival on the Donauinsel! 🇵🇭 Kultura Pop-Up @marikitmarkt 8 August | 1070 Vienna Celebrate Filipino culture with food, creative showcases, performances and more! 🌍 Afrika Tage @afrikatage 14 - 24 August | 1220 Vienna A festival celebrating Africa, with music, crafts, food, workshops and more, all on the Donauinsel! 🎭 Stumm & Laut 20 - 22 August | 1100 Vienna Open-air screenings of silent movies paired with live electronic music! 🍇 Neustifter Kirtag @neustifterkirtag 20 - 23 August | 1190 Vienna One of Vienna’s most beloved traditional fesitvals with live music, local wine, and Heurigen vibes. 🚗 Vienna Oldtimer Parade 22 August | 1010 Vienna Watch dozens of gorgeous restored vintage cars parade around the ring! 🍸 Liquid Market Vienna @liquid.market 27 - 29 August | 1140 Vienna Austria’s biggest cocktail festival with unlimited tastings, workshops and more! 🍷 Stammersdorfer Weintage 29 - 30 August | 1210 Vienna A wine festival with musical highlights and a tractor parade! 🎸 Gürtel Nightwalk @guertelnightwalk 29 August | 1080 Vienna An evening music festival between multiple venues on the gürtel, all raising money for a good cause. 📽️ Frameout @mqwien Until 29 August | 1070 Vienna Celebrate A free open-air festival in the MQ featuring documentaries, art films and experimental cinema. Did I miss any August 2026 Vienna events? Drop them in the comments! ✨and make sure to follow for more tips on Vienna events and things to do in Vienna! #viennaaustria #viennatrav

deals.postCaption: Can’t miss events in Vienna this August 2026 🥳 🏮 Alte Donau Lichterlfest 1 August | 1220 Vienna For one night the Alter Donau is covered in lights! 🎥 Film Festival an Rathausplatz @filmfestivalrathausplatz Until 6 September | 1010 Vienna Free nightly film + music performances in from of the Rathaus, with a wide range of delicious food and drinks! 🎬 Kino am Dach Until 12 September | 1070 Vienna Open-air movie screenings on the rooftop of the main library - the perfect Vienna summer evening! 🎶 Isle of Summer Featival @isleofsummer_vienna 1 August | 1220 Vienna A brand-new open air electronic music featival on the Donauinsel! 🇵🇭 Kultura Pop-Up @marikitmarkt 8 August | 1070 Vienna Celebrate Filipino culture with food, creative showcases, performances and more! 🌍 Afrika Tage @afrikatage 14 - 24 August | 1220 Vienna A festival celebrating Africa, with music, crafts, food, workshops and more, all on the Donauinsel! 🎭 Stumm & Laut 20 - 22 August | 1100 Vienna Open-air screenings of silent movies paired with live electronic music! 🍇 Neustifter Kirtag @neustifterkirtag 20 - 23 August | 1190 Vienna One of Vienna’s most beloved traditional fesitvals with live music, local wine, and Heurigen vibes. 🚗 Vienna Oldtimer Parade 22 August | 1010 Vienna Watch dozens of gorgeous restored vintage cars parade around the ring! 🍸 Liquid Market Vienna @liquid.market 27 - 29 August | 1140 Vienna Austria’s biggest cocktail festival with unlimited tastings, workshops and more! 🍷 Stammersdorfer Weintage 29 - 30 August | 1210 Vienna A wine festival with musical highlights and a tractor parade! 🎸 Gürtel Nightwalk @guertelnightwalk 29 August | 1080 Vienna An evening music festival between multiple venues on the gürtel, all raising money for a good cause. 📽️ Frameout @mqwien Until 29 August | 1070 Vienna Celebrate A free open-air festival in the MQ featuring documentaries, art films and experimental cinema. Did I miss any August 2026 Vienna events? Drop them in the comments! ✨and make sure to follow for more tips on Vienna events and things to do in Vienna! #viennaaustria #viennatrav
